cases.SA-a00:
# ADR 0167 (job 49D) run SA-a00; built on ADR 0159's case text
title = "NACA 0012, alpha 0 deg, steady SA, both fixes (freestream far-field role, effective force), mesh M1w-far500 (ADR 0167, job 49D)"

[mesh]
source = "file"
file = "../meshes/M1w-far500"

[mesh.transform]
rotate_z_deg = 0.0   # angle of attack 0 deg: the aerofoil turns by -alpha about the quarter chord (ADR 0155)
rotate_origin = [0.25, 0.0, 0.0]

[physics]
nu = 1.6666666666666667e-7   # Re = U c / nu = 6e6

[initial]
velocity = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]

[boundaries.airfoil]
velocity = "fixed"

[boundaries.farfield]
velocity = "freestream"
velocity_value = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
pressure = "freestream"
turbulence = "freestream"   # ADR 0164 amendment 1 (opt-in): nuTilda = 3 nu on the inflow faces, zero gradient on the outflow faces

[reports.cl]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total"   # ADR 0167: the molecular wall shear (today's default), written out

[reports.cd]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total"   # ADR 0167: the molecular wall shear (today's default), written out

[turbulence]
model = "spalart_allmaras"

[solver]
algorithm = "simplec"
convection = "linear_upwind"
max_iterations = 8000
min_iterations = 8000   # amendment 1: no stop at the residual targets before the cap (the forces still drift there)

[output]
store_interval = 8000   # the last snapshot only
store_precision = "f32"
store_fields = ["ux", "uy", "p", "nut"]

# ADR 0167: the effective force (ADR 0164 D1), the curve's values; and the parts of cd (reports do not change the solution)
[reports.cl_eff]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [0.0, 1.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total_effective"

[reports.cd_eff]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "total_effective"

[reports.cd_p]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "pressure"

[reports.cd_veff]
type = "force_coefficient"
patch = "airfoil"
direction = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
a_ref = 0.1
u_ref = 1.0
component = "viscous_effective"

[reports.nut_avg]
type = "volume_average"
field = "nut"
